lines.text: Many learners say: I have cold.
Say a cold when you are sick.
A cold! I have a cold.

data.why: Say a cold when you are sick.

native.tip: 「風邪をひいている」は have a cold。cold の前に a を入れます。
native.caption: “I have cold.”と言っていませんか？😅 日本語には「a」がないので、つい抜けがちです。“I have a cold.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“a cold”。“I have a cold.” を声に出して言ってみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: Say a cold: I have a cold.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I have cold.” 😅 Japanese has no a, so it is easy to drop. The natural way is “I have a cold.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
